note: Neutral scene contract the counting artifact sees. It describes the sensor and the pedestrian population, never the expected counts.

tripwire.note: a vertical counting line at x_fraction * width; east means +x

pedestrians.count_hint: roughly 15-25 distinct pedestrians appear over the clip; some only linger or turn back

background.note: static textured floor, slow sinusoidal global illumination drift over 20 s

artifact.contract: one row per detected tripwire crossing by a pedestrian, times in seconds from clip start, east/west are 0/1 and exactly one of them is 1 per row; rows sorted by t_cross_s; pedestrians only - anything wider than the body_w_px range (trolleys, forklifts) must not be counted
